description: Capture a PNG of a page as it renders. Send a URL and receive a PNG screenshot of the fully rendered page, captured by a real Chromium browser exiting through a French residential IP. JavaScript is executed and lazy-loaded content resolved before capture, so the image matches what a human visitor would see. Useful for agents that must verify a page visually, archive evidence of a listing or a price, or hand a rendered view to a vision model for analysis. — $0.010000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "screenshot this page", "take a picture of this URL", "capture this page as an image".
name: screenshot
